text:
maria (Docs): Heads-up — opened a docs PR to consolidate SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries across Python / TS / Go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — main goals: unify async iterator patterns, show backoff best-practice, and add a small migration note for the streaming cursor change. Asking @evan and @sam for API correctness review. :eyes:

ev an (SDK): Got it, I'll review today. Quick Q: does the Python sample include a helper for jittered backoff? We should recommend exp backoff + jitter.

maria (Docs): Yes — py uses an explicit helper: `backoff = ExponentialBackoff(base=0.2, max=5.0, jitter=True)` and the sample shows:```py
async for chunk in client.stream(model="x", prompt=prompt, retry=backoff):
    print(chunk.text)
```

sam (Eng): Can we add a one-line note about `client.stream(..., cursor=...)` — for Dedicated deployments users must pass the ordinal cursor (not the hash) or you'll get a 400. We keep seeing support tickets about this.

maria (Docs): Good call — added a bolded note in the Dedicated section and a snippet showing how to surface the ordinal cursor from the response.

ev an (SDK): For the TS example: prefer explicit reader usage rather than `for await` on the stream body. Suggest:```ts
const reader = resp.body.getReader();
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if (done) break;
  // process chunk (TextDecoder)
}
```

carla (Docs Review): nit: migration link at the top is broken (404). should point to `/docs/migrate/streaming` not `/docs/migrate/streams`.

docs-bot: CI check — markdown-lint: pass; code-snippets-test: fail in Go sample (go vet) — error: unused import "io" on line 12.

sam (Eng): I'll push a fix for the Go example: remove the unused import and demonstrate `io.Copy(dst, resp.Body)` to stream directly to an io.Writer instead of buffering. That should satisfy go vet.

ev an (SDK): Also — quick style: in TS example we shouldn't include a custom header like `x-redwood-retry` in public snippets. Better to show the SDK-level retry helper.

maria (Docs): Agreed, removed the custom header line from the TS sample. Updated the PR description noting that we avoid custom headers in public docs.

ben (PM): :thumbsup: timeline check — can we land this before Friday doc freeze? If not, mark as patch release.

maria (Docs): On track. Plan: Evan reviews today, Sam pushes Go fix, Carla final editorial pass tomorrow. I'll squash/merge after green CI.

ev an (SDK): left two inline comments about variable names (`resp` vs `response`) and one about clarifying the decoder usage. I'll approve after those tiny changes.

maria (Docs): Thanks all. Tagging @here for visibility. cc: @support-team — we'll update the internal KB / RUNBOOK with the cursor note after merge.

support-lead: Thanks — I'll coordinate the internal KB update and add a quick troubleshooting blurb for ordinal vs hash cursors.
